item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The Federal Government is urged to improve recruiting and career-development practices; this states executive policy and management priorities without itself altering legal status or compelling a specified later legal outcome.","evidence":"the Federal Government must improve its recruiting efforts"},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes the statutory good-administration finding necessary to except covered civil-service positions from competitive hiring rules; the legally consequential determination occurs in this segment.","evidence":"I find that conditions of good administration (specifically, the need to promote employment opportunities for students and recent graduates in the Federal workforce) make necessary an exception to the competitive hiring rules"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately establishes and names executive-branch employment programs, an internal organizational act rather than a direct alteration of individual legal rights.","evidence":"There are hereby established the Internship Program and the Recent Graduates Program"},{"segment_id":"4","code":2,"rationale":"The President mandates that the OPM Director later issue regulations implementing specified elements of the programs, with legally operative details to arise through those regulations.","evidence":"direct the Director of the Office of Personnel Management (OPM) to issue regulations implementing the Pathways Programs"},{"segment_id":"5","code":2,"rationale":"As part of the mandated regulations, OPM must prescribe performance-assessment requirements, oversight provisions, evaluation plans, and naming conventions; the specified regulatory outcomes occur later.","evidence":"requirements that managers meaningfully assess the performance of participants in the Pathways Programs"},{"segment_id":"6","code":3,"rationale":"The segment presently defines the Internship Program's paid-opportunity function and who qualifies for participant status, subject only to OPM determining qualifying institutions and programs.","evidence":"Participants in the program shall be referred to as \"Interns\" and shall be students enrolled, or accepted for enrollment, in qualifying educational institutions and programs"},{"segment_id":"7","code":1,"rationale":"Agencies receive internal directions concerning interns' work assignments and expectations, while OPM retains discretion over exceptions and treatment of third-party interns.","evidence":"agencies shall provide Interns with meaningful developmental work and set clear expectations regarding the work experience of the intern"},{"segment_id":"8","code":3,"rationale":"The segment itself establishes binding participant eligibility periods, including an extended eligibility window for qualifying veterans, and prescribes assignment standards.","evidence":"shall be eligible to participate in the Program within 6 years of obtaining a qualifying degree or completing a qualifying program"},{"segment_id":"9","code":4,"rationale":"The segment inseparably combines an internal delegation to OPM to establish future eligibility requirements with present binding rules governing appointment status, duration, employment rights, and possible conversion.","evidence":"Appointments to the Recent Graduates or PMF Programs shall not exceed 2 years"},{"segment_id":"10","code":1,"rationale":"The amendment authorizes OPM to except positions after making specified determinations and requires administrative reporting, but it does not itself except any position or dictate that OPM do so.","evidence":"OPM may except positions from the competitive service when it determines"},{"segment_id":"11","code":2,"rationale":"The amended rule requires OPM later to place positions it excepts into designated schedules, thereby mandating the administrative mechanism producing their formal classification.","evidence":"OPM shall list positions that it excepts from the competitive service in Schedules A, B, C, and D"},{"segment_id":"12","code":2,"rationale":"The rule dictates that positions meeting specified category criteria be listed in Schedules B, C, or D, with excepted-service consequences arising when OPM administers those listings.","evidence":"These positions, which are temporarily placed in the excepted service to enable more effective recruitment from all segments of society by using means of recruiting and assessing candidates that diverge from the rules generally applicable to the competitive service, shall be listed in Schedule D."},{"segment_id":"13","code":3,"rationale":"The segment immediately amends the governing rule so that civil-service removal rules no longer apply to specified positions, directly changing the legal regime governing removals.","evidence":"the Civil Service Rules and Regulations shall not apply to removals from positions listed in Schedules A, C, or D"},{"segment_id":"14","code":4,"rationale":"This segment inseparably combines discretionary OPM authority and internal administration, mandatory agency procedures, immediate and contingent revocations of prior orders, and a future automatic conversion of affected employees to competitive-service status.","evidence":"Any individuals serving in appointments under that order on March 1, 2011, shall be converted to the competitive service"},{"segment_id":"15","code":1,"rationale":"These provisions constrain implementation to existing law, appropriations, authorities, and OMB functions; they are executive housekeeping and interpretive safeguards rather than a new substantive legal consequence.","evidence":"This order shall be implemented consistent with applicable law and subject to the availability of appropriations"}]}
